newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-JONES APPOINTED AS SOUTHAMPTON MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JONES APPOINTED AS SOUTHAMPTON MANAGER.

text.p: David Jones, who led Stockport County to promotion to the English first division last season, has been appointed manager of premier league Southampton, Southampton said on Monday.
Jones has signed a four-year contract and replaces Graeme Souness who quit last month.
Stockport assistant manager John Sainty will also join Southampton as Jones's assistant.
"This is the proudest moment of my footballing career," Jones said in a statement.
"Rupert Lowe and the new board of the club have an impressive vision for Southampton Football Club and taking on this job was an offer I could not turn down."
